newsDocuments.headline: Turkish seismic vessel arrives in Karachi to begin offshore oil, gas survey

segments.text: A Turkish seismic vessel, Orus Reis, arrived at Karachi port on Friday to begin exploring for oil and gas in Pakistan’s offshore waters, officials said, marking a new phase in energy cooperation between Pakistan and Turkiye.

Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar, who arrived in Karachi a day earlier, joined Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar, Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik and other Pakistani officials to receive the vessel.

The vessel will carry out seismic surveys in Pakistan’s offshore blocks, which Islamabad auctioned for oil and gas exploration for the first time in two decades as part of efforts to revive domestic exploration and reduce reliance on import
